description: Held-out benchmark. Do not tune the prompt against these cases; run once per prompt version and report the result as-is.
changelog: 1.0.0 — 18 unseen cases written after prompt v2 was frozen: 10 single-fallacy, 2 multi-fallacy, 6 clean/hard-negative.
